# section: # Installed as an overlay (exec/finite_rules.py): later rows override earlier edges in place.
# dispatch: DISPATCH reads a byte; its class's lex.tsv row is constant (HANDLE, state DISPATCH)
# or needs the next byte (PEEKCLASS: PEEK:class, then H:action re-reads the first byte).
# A handler is the entry.tsv rows of its action restricted to the class; linked entries continue
# in the identifier trie root (IDROOT), number.tsv NSTART, or the punctuator trie root (OPROOT).
# ident: one state per prefix of the special words (IDPFX); a child prefix continues the trie,
# any other identifier byte goes to ID*.  The end of the name: skipparen -> SKW:word, drop -> DISPATCH,
# else the token (kind of the word, id otherwise); string/char prefixes before quote bytes.
# punct: maximal munch as a trie over the punctuator prefixes (OPPFX); the state remembers the
# longest punctuator read so far; no child: emit it, rewinding to its end unless the node is one.
